item.title: Attorney General Ellison wins dismissal of Trump Administration lawsuit demanding Minnesota’s voter rolls
item.description:
Publication Date: August 17, 2026

Court rules federal government does not have the right to go on a ‘fishing expedition’ to see whether Minnesota has not maintained its voter rolls when it made no allegation that Minnesota failed to do so
